facts.headline: Indigenous Leaders Confront Climate, Conflict, and Extraction at the UN
facts.summary: Hundreds of Indigenous leaders convene in Geneva to confront overlapping crises of climate change, conflict, and resource extraction. They highlight how militarization and legal marginalization reinforce one another, leaving communities vulnerable to displacement and violence. The gathering underscores that protecting Indigenous rights requires upholding free, prior, and informed consent against accelerating global pressures.
